---
name: "MiniPdf Azure Bicep Rules"
description: "Use when editing Azure Bicep or Bicep parameter files in MiniPdf."
applyTo: "**/*.bicep,**/*.bicepparam"

# Azure Bicep Rules

- Use Azure tools when handling Azure resources.
- Invoke Azure best practices before authoring or modifying Bicep.
- If the Azure best-practices tool is unavailable, ask the user to enable it.
